# Le029 — Header `FILE_DESCRIPTION` strings containing commas or parentheses (regex-split bug)

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

## Sources
- T041/step-file-parser #8

## Description

Header parsers implemented as regex-split-on-comma fail when a description string contains literal commas or balanced parentheses. Real IFC and STEP headers commonly carry both.

## Reproducer recipe

`FILE_DESCRIPTION(('a, b (c)','d'),'2;1');`

## Expected kernel behavior

tokenise strings before splitting parameters; treat `'…'` content opaquely.
